subject: general
question: Banas is a tributary of which of the following rivers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chambal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Banas is a river that lies entirely within the state of Rajasthan in western India.
 
• It is a tributary of the **Chambal River__, itself a tributary of the Yamuna, which in turn merges into the Ganga**.
 
• The Banas is approximately 512 kilometres in length.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• ​Banas River is known as the **Van Ki Asha (Hope of the forest)**.

 
 
• Banas river originated from Veron ka Math.
 
 
 
• Chambal river originated from Janapav.
 
 
• The chambal river meets the Yamuna river at the Etawah district.
